mechanism: Carbamazepine is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce amoxicillin clavulanate levels; additionally, amoxicillin clavulanate may inhibit carbamazepine metabolism leading to increased carbamazepine levels and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor carbamazepine levels and signs of toxicity (ataxia, diplopia, dizziness); consider therapeutic drug monitoring and dose adjustment if needed; ensure adequate antibiotic efficacy.
